sub_graphs.title: EIP-7917: Effective Balance Grinding Prevention
sub_graphs.description: Models the security mechanism preventing effective balance manipulation for proposer selection

ambiguities.text: The specification lacks explicit handling of edge cases such as validator activation/exit timing relative to lookahead calculations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard validator lifecycle rules apply. Validators must be active for the target epoch at the time of lookahead computation to be eligible.

ambiguities.text: No recovery procedures if lookahead corruption occurs
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume consensus failure if lookahead becomes corrupted. Clients would need to resync from a valid state.

ambiguities.text: Computing the proposer index is light, involving sampling validators until we reach a validator with sufficient effective balance
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume sampling follows existing beacon chain proposer selection algorithm with effective balance weighting.

implicit_assumptions.description: RANDAO values from MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1 epochs prior are unpredictable at the time effective balances are set
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If RANDAO values can be predicted further in advance, attackers could still grind effective balances to influence proposer selection

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate their effective balance after observing the RANDAO outcome to gain proposer status
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The entire security model of deterministic lookahead breaks down, allowing proposer slot grinding attacks

implicit_assumptions.description: Beacon state storage can accommodate the additional proposer_lookahead vector
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Increased state size could impact node performance or storage requirements

implicit_assumptions.description: Epoch boundary processing time is not significantly impacted by lookahead computation
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Delayed epoch processing could impact slot timing and consensus
